name: py-simba-pop
summary: A Python implementation of the SIMBA-POP cohort model described by Tixier, Malézieux & Dorel (2004, Ecological Modelling 180:407–417), including the flowering-rate correction of Ochoa (2010) and the cohort-basis reading of Guarín & Ochoa (2012). The engineering and the data-driven extensions (observed ribbon/bagging routing, Modes B/C) are by the author. Not affiliated with or endorsed by CIRAD or the original authors.
